name: @pgmi-builds/agent-codex-sdk
description: Codex (SDK) provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — the OPT-IN in-process SDK transport for the Codex agent: it embeds Codex threads in this Node process instead of driving a `codex app-server` child (that is @pgmi-builds/agent-codex, the PRIMARY path, because it reuses the operator's own codex binary). Delivered DISABLED by default (world key `codex-sdk`, roster label "Codex (SDK)"); turning the composite row on IS the switch. This package declares NO SDK dependency — not a dependency, not an optionalDependency and not a peer — and ships NO postinstall: the durable SDK tree (the codex SDK package plus the pinned codex binary package) is fetched into the world home on the first real prompt (src/sdk-runtime.ts, `npm run fetch-sdk-runtime`).
